flags.observation: 125 characters, longest line; all eighteen opener lines exceed 95 characters and break the one-breath limit.
"So the mirror bends" lands four beats after "So the fairground opens"; same opener family under ten lines apart.
"But the megaphone interrupts" follows "But the Invisible Rucksack's weight" by seven beats; family spacing under ten lines.
Card name sung as "The Guarantee"; the printed name is truncated, owner dropped from the title.
"sell a false solution confidently" recites the power nearly verbatim; sounds like a rule, not an aside.
"helping behavior repeats even when it fails" restates the power as the line's payload; rulebook register.
Opener "But the emergency brake" repeats the line's closing image "emergency brake"; the bridge adds no turn.
"Future left: Future Self: The One Who Left" stacks two colons and doubles Future and Left; stumbles aloud.
"burden" spoken three times in one beat: "old burden", "burden into object", "labeled burden".
"two chairs facing setup" is a clipped artwork fragment; ungrammatical when spoken.
Tail "work, love, sanity, chaos, balanced" is a noun list; the card shows no want, wound or grudge.
"Nobody can sell the whistle back" calls back to the intro, but the turn stays opaque; satirical edge of frame faint.
